info.title: Hikoo REST API
info.description: Programmatic access to your Hikoo data: AI citations, prompts, topics, competitors, sources, audits, site health, indexation, AI-crawler traffic, and outreach. Authenticate with a personal API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Create one in the dashboard under **Settings > API keys**.

List every workspace you are a member of.

get.description: List the websites you can access, paginated. Each item includes `has_active_subscription`. Websites without an active subscription are listed, but their data endpoints answer `403`.
Return the website detail (subscription, plan, settings) for the given website_id.

Plan details for the website: plan tier, product name, status, trial and expiry dates, AI platforms covered, available features and quotas. Restricted to workspace owners and admins; other members get `403`.
AI-agent traffic dashboard: totals, per-vendor rows and a visit trend.

Aggregated stats on indexed pages: total, by category, health pass rate,
pages with errors or warnings, last crawl timestamp.
Status of the latest indexation run (running, completed or failed) with its progress counters.

Paginated list of indexed pages, with filters on category, health,
errors, warnings, language, derived status, and URL/title search.

Each page carries `search_metrics`: clicks and impressions from Google
Search Console (`google`) and Bing Webmaster Tools (`bing`), totals
over the time filter (`time_range` 1w, 1m, 1y or all_time, counted back
from the latest day with data; or `date_from` / `date_to`, which win;
all time by default), null per provider when the site has not connected
it. `search_sources` gives the exact days each provider's totals cover.
`sort_by` (google_impressions, google_clicks, bing_impressions,
bing_clicks) with `sort_direction` orders the list by one of them.

post.description: Ask Hikoo to write a pitch for this source. The call answers right away. The draft lands in the approval queue a few seconds later, never in a mailbox: read the source again to get it.

patch.description: Edit a draft. Any edit revokes a previous approval.

post.description: Approve a pitch. It leaves from your own mailbox, inside your sending hours and limits. Only the person who owns the source can approve it.

patch.description: Declare what happened after the message went out.
Correct the match, or switch to the alternate contact.

put.description: Move the next follow-up of a waiting opportunity to another day.

post.description: Do not send the next follow-up of a waiting opportunity.

Ask for an answer to a reply Hikoo stopped on: ask their price, offer
up to an amount, turn the fee down. Nothing is sent and nothing is paid
by this call: it adds a request to the decision card, which a person
confirms in Hikoo ("i_will_reply" alone applies at once).

Ask Hikoo to be allowed to talk price on one source, up to an amount.

Nothing is authorised by this call: it opens a request on the source's
decision card, which the workspace owner or an admin confirms in Hikoo
(single use, expires in 48 hours). The workspace money limits are checked
now (409 above them) and again at the confirmation.

get.description:
Everything the Outreach home shows, counted once.

The three things waiting on a person, the results, what the agent is doing
right now, the tab counts and the first page of rows, all from one
grouping. An agent asked "what needs me" answers from this.
Active opportunities grouped as the work screen groups them.
What Hikoo and the user did, newest first, grouped by day.

post.description:
Tell Hikoo what to change in a pitch.

With a selection only that passage is sent to the model and only its
replacement comes back. The signature is out of scope either way: it
belongs to the mailbox and is appended at send time.

What the agent may offer. Empty means never pay, which is the default.

Setting a ceiling is not spending it: every message naming a figure still
waits for a person to approve it.
How many times Hikoo comes back, and after how long.

What the brand can offer a publisher, replaced as a whole list.
Empty means a description of the brand and a link, nothing else.
Who the mailboxes write as. Empty goes back to the decision by domain.

get.description:

Nothing leaves without one, so "why is nothing being sent" is usually

post.description: Create a new prompt. Fails if the website's prompt quota is reached.
Apply the same change (topic, markets, intent, journey stage) to many prompts at once. Only the fields you send change; send `null` to clear a field. Returns `{updated: <count>}`.

Archive many active prompts at once, kept until they are restored.

Prompts already archived, deleted or still drafts are skipped. Returns

Archive an active prompt: it stops being tracked, frees its quota slot
and keeps its history, without expiry, until it is restored.

Restore an archived prompt, optionally swapping with an active one.

`replace_with` names an active prompt to archive in exchange. Required
once the website has no free prompt slot, optional before that.

get.description:
Look a URL up across AI-cited sources and AI-crawler traffic.

`sources` covers citations: how many AI answers cited a matching URL,
on which platforms, from which prompts, and whether the URL was shown to
the user (mentioned) or only consulted in the background.

`agent_traffic` covers agent analytics: how many times AI crawlers
fetched a matching page and which agents did. `agent_traffic.enabled`
is false when the plan doesn't include agent analytics, no hits then
means "not measured", not "never visited".

parameters.name: url

schema.description: URL or URL fragment to look up. Scheme, www., query string and fragment are stripped before matching, so a pasted browser URL works as-is. A bare path (/blog) or a bare domain also work.

apiKey.description: Personal API key created in the dashboard under Settings > API keys.

Unauthorized.description: The `Authorization` header is missing, malformed, or the key is invalid, expired or revoked.

Forbidden.description: The key is valid but not allowed to do this: the website has no active subscription, your role in the workspace is read-only for a write request, or your email is not verified.

example.detail: This website has no active subscription, so its data is unavailable.

X-Error-Code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, when one applies (for example `rate_limited`).

NotFound.description: The website, or the resource in the path, does not exist or is not visible to this key.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests for this API key. Wait for the number of seconds in `Retry-After`.

example.detail: Too many requests. Please try again shortly.

X-Error-Code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, when one applies (for example `rate_limited`).

tags.name: Account
tags.description: The user behind the API key.

tags.name: Workspaces
tags.description: Workspaces the user belongs to. Use them to find the websites you can query.

tags.name: Websites
tags.description: Every website the user can access, with its subscription status.

tags.name: Website
tags.description: Metadata and plan of one website.

tags.name: Citations
tags.description: Every time an AI assistant answers one of your prompts, Hikoo stores the answer as a citation. These endpoints list them and aggregate them by platform, source, sentiment and match type.

tags.name: Prompts
tags.description: Prompts are the questions Hikoo sends to AI assistants for a website. Create, edit, archive and restore them, and read their visibility, answers and citations.

tags.name: Topics
tags.description: Topics group prompts. Every prompt belongs to one topic.

tags.name: Search queries
tags.description: The web searches AI assistants run internally (query fan-out) before answering your prompts.

tags.name: URL lookup
tags.description: Where one URL shows up, across AI-cited sources and AI-crawler traffic, in one call.

tags.name: Competitors
tags.description: Tracked competitors, their share of voice, and the competitor suggestions Hikoo detects in AI answers.

tags.name: Source intelligence
tags.description: The domains and pages AI assistants cite for your prompts, and who appears on them.

tags.name: Audits
tags.description: GEO audits of a full site, a list of pages or a single URL.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Site-level checks for AI readiness (robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap) and improvement suggestions.

tags.name: Indexation
tags.description: The pages Hikoo crawled on your website, their category, health and errors.

tags.name: Content gaps
tags.description: Topics where AI assistants answer without citing you, with a content brief for each.

tags.name: Agent analytics
tags.description: Traffic from AI crawlers and AI agents on your website.

tags.name: Outreach
tags.description: The outreach agent: sources worth getting cited on, their contacts, the pitches waiting for approval, follow-ups, and what the agent is allowed to do on its own.
